evidence: The development, deployment and use of artificial intelligence ("AI") technologies present new risks and challenges that could adversely impact our business
We are beginning to integrate AI and machine learning technologies into our business to enhance our operations, products, technology, and services

AI technologies may be developed using inaccurate, incomplete, flawed or biased algorithms, training methodologies or data, which could result in competitive harm, regulatory penalties, legal liability, or brand or reputational harm
ai_positioning.summary: La société BLFS intègre l'IA dans ses opérations et produits, mais est consciente des risques et défis associés à cette technologie
